title: Port StepGridView onto Vellum views in the Vellum audio package

installed_sdk.rationale: The Vellum audio package is an optional integration that is not part of the installed SDK; the installed pulp/view/step_grid_view.hpp is unchanged and stays until the legacy view layer is removed.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: This port adds a Vellum view over the existing sequencer state channel and no offline Timeline CLI surface.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: This port adds a Vellum view over the existing sequencer state channel and no offline Timeline MCP surface.

live_product_control.rationale: The view submits the same channel commands the legacy view does and adds no new live Product control operation.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: No design-time agent capability is added; the view is not registered in the capability manifest.
